newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singamas gains from Hong Kong sentiment.
newsitem.headline: Singamas gains from Hong Kong sentiment.

text.p: Maker of dry freight containers Singamas Container Holdings Lts led the Singapore actives on Tuesday, reflecting gains of its shares listed in Hong Kong, dealers said.
At 0325 GMT, with more than 4.5 million traded, the shares were trading up HK$0.20 at HK$1.10 after hitting a new year high of HK$1.11.
The Hong Kong-listed Singamas shares were HK$0.34 higher at HK$1.24, with more than 42 million shares.
"It is riding along with its Hong Kong counterpart," said a dealer with a local house, adding that she was unaware of any particular corporate reason for the price rise.
"The share hasn't been doing well. But the Hong Kong market is expected to propel along towards the end of the month. That could be a reason," the dealer said.
On May 15, Singamas reported a net loss of about HK$69 million for the financial year ended December 31, 1996 against a profit of HK$2.15 in 1995.
